headline: Strategic Plan for 2026 to 2032 approved 5-0; consent agenda approved 4-0.
summary: Vendor WhiteWater reviewed the school's drinking water wells, storage tank, and wastewater plant. The panel also heard a middle school update and reviewed the 2027 budget rollover. Members approved the Strategic Plan and the consent agenda.
discussion: WhiteWater systems review: Members asked about the drinking water wells, backup water supply, and the age of the wastewater tank. Vendor staff said the 1998 tank is near the end of its expected life.
Library selection policy: Members asked how safeguards would work now that the school has no librarian. They also asked about the three-year waiting period for challenging materials.
Middle school attendance: Staff said chronic absenteeism lowered the school's accountability rating. Members discussed consequences and incentives for attendance.
Budget rollover: Members reviewed increases by building and the cost of outsourcing support services.

decision_evidence.quote: I move to approve the consent agenda as presented. Rea Erickson, second. ... Darling, aye. Matera, aye. Roy, aye. Rea-Erickson, aye. Passes 4-0.
I move to approve the Strategic Plan for 2026 to 2032 as presented. ... Great, motion passed, 5-0.
